source: Rebuilt from the workbook's own consumer formulas — 14 missing links found and applied

sections.title: Does this actually go through the prep?
sections.intro: In each of these the app sends an ingredient through one of our own preparations, and the production sheet does not. Both can look right on paper — the question is what the team actually does. If the raw ingredient goes straight into the mix, the app is making work that does not happen; if it goes through the prep, the sheet is under-ordering. Five lines, biggest first.

sections.title: Two real quantity differences
sections.intro: For these two the app and the sheet agree completely on what feeds what — nothing missing, nothing extra. So the difference is a genuine quantity, not a wiring fault. Everything else that looked like a quantity problem this morning turned out to be a missing link, and has fixed itself.

sections.title: Two quick confirmations
sections.intro: Both of these already have an explanation. A yes closes them.

sections.title: One we cannot answer from the sheet
sections.intro: The workbook has no tab for this, so nobody but the kitchen knows.

items.title: Does Primavera use roasted peppers, or frozen ones?
items.evidence: The app has “Primavera” (7.62 kg) drawing its “Red Peppers IQF” from the Roasted Red Peppers prep, at 0.1692/kg — which adds 1.29 kg to what we make. The production sheet does not: it says Roasted Red Peppers is only for Wild Rice, Peppers and Squash. This is most of why red peppers now read 7.51 kg against the sheet's 5.32. So — do the peppers get roasted first and then go into Primavera, or do the frozen ones go straight in?
options: Uses the prep — app is right
Raw goes straight in — unlink it

items.title: Does Verde use steamed peas, or frozen straight in?
items.evidence: The app has “Verde” (3.46 kg) drawing its “Peas, IQF” from the Peas, Steamed prep, at 0.3/kg — which adds 1.04 kg to what we make. The production sheet does not: it says Peas, Steamed is only for Egg Fried Basmati and Farfalle Verde. Peas currently read 3.90 kg against the sheet's 2.36. This line is the biggest part of it. So — do the peas get steamed first and then go into Verde, or do the frozen ones go straight in?
options: Uses the prep — app is right
Raw goes straight in — unlink it

items.title: Does Thai Green Curry use steamed peas?
items.evidence: The app has “Thai Green Curry Sauce” (4.92 kg) drawing its “Peas” from the Peas, Steamed prep, at 0.07/kg — which adds 0.34 kg to what we make. The production sheet does not: it says Peas, Steamed is only for Egg Fried Basmati and Farfalle Verde. Smaller than the Verde line, but the same question. So — do the peas get steamed first, or do the frozen ones go straight into the curry?
options: Uses the prep — app is right
Raw goes straight in — unlink it

items.title: Does Squash Risotto use the roasted squash prep?
items.evidence: The app has “Squash Risotto” (4.37 kg) drawing its “Butternut Squash, roasted 20x20” from the Roasted Butternut Squash prep, at 0.15/kg — which adds 0.66 kg to what we make. The production sheet does not: it says Roasted Butternut Squash is only for Butternut Squash Kale & Pearl Barley, and Wild Rice Peppers & Squash. The line says roasted, so this one may well be right and the sheet simply routes risotto differently. So — does the risotto take squash from the roasting tray, or is it roasted as part of the risotto itself?
options: Uses the prep — app is right
Raw goes straight in — unlink it

items.title: Does New Gravy use the steamed diced carrot?
items.evidence: The app has “New Gravy” (3.3 kg) drawing its “Carrots, diced 5mm” from the Carrots Diced, Steamed prep, at 0.0642/kg — which adds 0.21 kg to what we make. The production sheet does not: it says Carrots Diced, Steamed is only for Egg Fried Basmati and Biryani. New Gravy has no tab in the production workbook at all, so the sheet cannot settle this one either way. Claude added this link earlier today from the ingredient name alone. So — does the gravy take carrot from the steamer, or does the diced carrot go in raw and cook in the gravy?
options: Uses the prep — app is right
Raw goes straight in — unlink it

items.title: Green Beans
items.evidence: Sheet 6.07 kg · app 4.3 kg — the app wants 1.77 kg less. Both sides agree these go into “Green Beans, SKU 3, 22” and “Orzo Salad” — nothing is missing or extra. So this is a real quantity difference, not a wiring one. Either the grams per portion or the steaming yield is out.

items.title: Orzo
items.evidence: Sheet 3.073 kg · app 4.39 kg — the app wants 1.32 kg more. Both sides agree Orzo only goes into Orzo Salad. Nothing missing or extra, so again a real quantity difference — the app wants 1.3 kg more dry orzo than the sheet.

items.title: Baby Corn — is the difference the Simmer top-up?
items.evidence: Sheet 0.615 kg · app 0.50 kg. The gap is almost exactly the six Simmer meals on SKU 65 that the D2C import does not pick up — the same cause as the Thai Green Curry line. Confirm and this closes.

items.title: Diced carrot — confirming the Biryani entry is the phantom
items.evidence: Sheet 8.53 kg · app 0.90 kg, which looks alarming until you read the sheet's own formula: 7.2 kg of that 8.53 is Biryani, driven by SKU 74 at 90 kg. SKU 74 is at quantity zero on All Dishes and James has already confirmed it was typed into the workbook by hand in error. Excluding it, the sheet wants 0.605 kg against the app's 0.90. Just confirming nobody is actually making Biryani this week.

items.title: Sweetcorn, Roasted
items.evidence: 0.63 kg is going onto the raw-materials list under this name, for Egg Fried Basmati Rice. The name says it has already been roasted, but there is no recipe for it — and the production sheet has no tab for it either, so it cannot answer this one. Do we buy roasted sweetcorn, or roast it here?
options: We roast it — needs a recipe
